capabilities: remove blank lines between list items via a Command Palette command
toggle strict mode that removes only indented blank lines inside lists
merge consecutive lists by removing all blank lines between them (all mode)
remove trailing indented blank lines after the last list item
preserve pure empty blank lines as separators between distinct lists in strict mode
extras: Not yet available in the Obsidian community plugin store; must be installed manually by cloning and building from source. Not reviewed by Obsidian staff. Apache 2.0 license with attribution notice; author accepts donations via Buy Me a Coffee and GitHub Sponsors.
motivation: The author built it because copying list content from AI tools like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini into Obsidian adds unnecessary tabbed blank lines between each list item.
problem: Indented blank lines sneak into Markdown lists (often from copying text out of chat tools), making lists render as loose or visually odd, and Obsidian has no built-in cleanup for this.
summary: Markdown list cleaner that removes unwanted blank lines between list items via a Command Palette command, with a strict mode that preserves separators between distinct lists.
